verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Copilot can connect to files/emails/calendars and store some remembered facts (copilot-docs-32, copilot-docs-7), but there is no mention of a 'project' or 'space' construct that groups related chats and files together with shared instructions/context, unlike competitors' project/space features. Missing for 10: any documented project/space organization feature, shared custom instructions per project, grouping of chats/files into a persistent workspace.
